title: spec(smart-guitar): revise scale length to 25.5 in / 647.7 mm
intent: Owner-directed revision of the Smart Guitar scale length from 628.65 mm / 24.75 in to 647.7 mm / 25.5 in, mirroring CNC-Production-Shop PR #16 which carries the full rationale. The 628.65 was Gibson heritage inherited from the Explorer and Les Paul parents recorded in instrument.design_heritage; both CNC product-line baselines already declare 25.5 in, so on this figure the Smart Guitar was the deviation from its own product line and this returns it to the baseline. Data-only: no Python in services/api reads the constant.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) neck.scale_length_inches 24.75 -> 25.5 and neck.scale_length_mm 628.65 -> 647.7, with a new neck.scale_length_note recording the authority, the date, that 25.5 in is the specified figure and 647.7 mm its exact conversion, and that the design_heritage reference values are deliberately untouched. (2) cavities.bridge_route.body_position_mm.notes reworded from a note tying the position to the superseded scale into an explicit STALE flag: the bridge station is scale-derived and moves 19.05 mm toward the tail, both pickup routes are bridge-referenced and follow it, and the value is NOT recomputed here because every cavity position in this spec is withdrawn pending a trustworthy body outline. y_from_top itself is left at 320.0. (3) The trailing summary note and the docs spec table line updated from 'Gibson 24.75 scale' to the revised figure. (4) The CBSP21 patch-input gate now reads git diff paths with NUL delimiters and core.quotepath=false so filenames containing spaces and Unicode punctuation match manifest declarations exactly; a checker-level regression covers the Smart Guitar docs filename. The existing CBSP21 workflow quoting fix is declared in this manifest so the PR diff is complete.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: This is the toolbox half of a two-repo change; the CNC half revises fixtures/products/smart_guitar_v1.json and regenerates docs/geometry/SMART_GUITAR_CAD_DIMENSIONS.md. Neither repo is self-consistent with the other until both merge. Nothing else in this repo carries the constant.

python -c 'import json; json.load(open(spec))' -> parses; scale_length_mm 647.7, 647.7/25.4 == 25.5 exactly
design_heritage.explorer.reference_scale_mm and .les_paul.reference_scale_mm confirmed still 628.65 after the edit

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Medium: the sheet and the CNC records now agree at 25.5 in while any fretboard already sourced against 24.75 in is the wrong part - slot spacing is scale-specific, and the CNC neck make-or-buy estimate is flagged stale in the companion PR. Low: design_heritage reference values intentionally left at 628.65 because they are facts about a Gibson Explorer and a Les Paul, not about this instrument; changing them would falsify a citation. Low: the Khaya sibling in CNC still reads 628.65 and whether it follows is an owner decision, not a consequence of this change.
